# Nick Esselman

Nick Esselman is a Netherlands-based full-stack developer and maker working across software, virtual reality, games, hardware, LED systems and custom PCB design.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio](https://nickesselman.nl/): Profile, selected work and current activity.
- [PartyVR](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/partyvr/): Room-scale multiplayer VR platform with host and spectator systems.
- [LAMP](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/lamp/): RP2040 controller for chained LED panels.
- [MYMacropad](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/mymacropad/): Custom 4×4 macropad, from PCB and firmware to enclosure.
- [Shelly Control Board](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/kennemer/): Local-first control interface for Shelly-powered devices.
- [Monkey Swing](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/monkey-swing/): A finished Unity swing game.
- [Blipstorm](https://nickesselman.nl/projects/blipstorm/): A playable Godot island-defence prototype.
